package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.util.Locale;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.repository.OwnerRepository;

/**
 * Assigns the owner's {@code customerCode}, formatted {@code <CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>}
 * where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased
 * first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
 * equal to one more than the owners already in that city (e.g. {@code TOW-SMI-0007}).
 * Runs before the owner is saved, so the count reflects the existing owners only.
 */
public class AssignCustomerCode {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
        String city = owner.getCity();
        String city3 = firstThreeUpper(city);
        String last3 = firstThreeUpper(owner.getLastName());
        long inCity = ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
            .filter(existing -> city.equals(existing.getCity()))
            .count();
        long sequence = inCity + 1;
        owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
    }

    private static String firstThreeUpper(String value) {
        return value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}

description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with sharesHousehold true; every owner in that household
                carries the same value. Null when the owner is not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level: a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present,
                gains a further 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount
                is 0), and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value that all duplicate detection is expressed
                through, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) +
                '|' + (householdId or empty). A new owner is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have distinct keys. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same effective business day;
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
